title: Introducing the Quo Housecall Pro Integration
summary: A call comes in, and you're flipping between tabs to figure out who's calling. Not anymore. Quo now integrates directly with Housecall Pro.
body_markdown:
If you run Housecall Pro alongside Quo, you know the struggle: a call comes in, and you’re flipping between tabs to figure out who’s calling and what job they’re tied to. Not anymore. Quo now integrates directly with Housecall Pro. Here’s how it works:


##


**Sync Housecall Pro customers to Quo**


Connect your Housecall Pro API key, and your customers automatically show up as contacts in Quo. Customer information refreshes every hour, so there’s no manual resync needed.


##


**Automatically log call and text activity to jobs**


When a call or text matches a customer, the recording and AI summary automatically log to their Housecall Pro job.


##


**Keep Housecall Pro as your source of truth**


Customer data flows one way, from Housecall Pro into Quo, so your customer records stay managed in Housecall Pro.


##


**Get started with the Quo Housecall Pro integration**


[Connect Housecall Pro](https://get.quo.com/housecallpro) now from the Quo web or desktop app.
